name: Bali, Indonesia
description: Experience the magic of Bali with its stunning beaches, ancient temples, and vibrant culture. This tropical paradise offers the perfect blend of relaxation and adventure. Explore lush rice terraces, visit sacred temples, enjoy world-class surfing, and indulge in luxurious spa treatments.
highlights: Visit the iconic Tanah Lot Temple
Explore the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary
Relax on pristine beaches of Seminyak and Nusa Dua
Experience traditional Balinese dance performances
Trek through the stunning Tegalalang Rice Terraces
included: Round-trip flights from major Indian cities
Guided temple tours with English-speaking guide

itinerary.title: Arrival in Bali
itinerary.description: Arrive at Ngurah Rai International Airport. Meet and greet by our representative. Transfer to your beach resort in Seminyak. Evening at leisure to relax by the pool or explore the nearby beach.

itinerary.title: Ubud Cultural Tour
itinerary.description: Visit the Sacred Monkey Forest, explore Ubud Art Market, witness traditional Balinese dance at Ubud Palace, and trek through the magnificent Tegalalang Rice Terraces.

itinerary.title: Temple Trail
itinerary.description: Full day temple tour visiting Tanah Lot Temple, Uluwatu Temple, and Besakih Temple. Experience the spectacular sunset at Uluwatu with traditional Kecak dance performance.

itinerary.title: Water Sports & Beach Day
itinerary.description: Enjoy water sports at Tanjung Benoa including parasailing, banana boat rides, and jet skiing. Afternoon at leisure on Nusa Dua beach for relaxation.

itinerary.title: Island Hopping
itinerary.description: Day trip to Nusa Penida island. Visit Kelingking Beach, Angel's Billabong, and Broken Beach. Snorkeling at Crystal Bay to see vibrant marine life.

itinerary.title: Spa & Shopping
itinerary.description: Morning spa session with traditional Balinese massage. Afternoon shopping at Seminyak's boutiques and art galleries. Farewell dinner at a beachfront restaurant.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast at the resort. Check-out and transfer to the airport for your return flight home with wonderful memories of Bali.

name: Manali, Himachal Pradesh
description: Discover the breathtaking beauty of Manali nestled in the Himalayas. Experience snow-capped mountains, adventure sports, and serene landscapes. Perfect for nature lovers and adventure enthusiasts seeking an escape from city life.
highlights: Visit the ancient Hadimba Temple
Adventure activities at Solang Valley
Explore Rohtang Pass (subject to weather)
Natural hot springs at Vashisht
Shopping at Mall Road and Old Manali

itinerary.title: Arrival in Manali
itinerary.description: Arrive in Manali and check into your hotel. Evening free to explore Mall Road and local markets. Overnight stay in Manali.

itinerary.title: Manali Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Hadimba Temple, Manu Temple, and the Tibetan Monastery. Explore Vashisht hot springs and Old Manali. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Solang Valley Adventure
itinerary.description: Full day excursion to Solang Valley. Enjoy paragliding, zorbing, and cable car rides. Experience the stunning mountain views and adventure activities.

itinerary.title: Rohtang Pass Excursion
itinerary.description: Early morning trip to Rohtang Pass (subject to permit and weather). Experience snow activities and breathtaking mountain panoramas. Return to Manali by evening.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out from hotel. Departure with wonderful memories of your Manali adventure.

name: Dubai, UAE
description: Experience the luxury and grandeur of Dubai, a city where modern architecture meets Arabian heritage. From world-class shopping to thrilling desert safaris, Dubai offers an unforgettable experience for every traveler.
highlights: Visit the iconic Burj Khalifa observation deck
Desert safari with dune bashing and BBQ dinner
Explore the traditional Gold and Spice Souks
Dhow cruise along Dubai Creek
Visit the architectural marvel of Burj Al Arab
included: Dubai city tour with Burj Khalifa tickets
All transfers and tours in AC vehicle

itinerary.title: Arrival in Dubai
itinerary.description: Arrive at Dubai International Airport. Transfer to hotel and check-in. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Dubai.

itinerary.title: Dubai City Tour
itinerary.description: Half-day city tour covering Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, and traditional souks. Evening visit to Burj Khalifa's observation deck on the 124th floor.

itinerary.title: Desert Safari Adventure
itinerary.description: Morning at leisure. Afternoon desert safari with dune bashing, camel riding, sandboarding, and traditional Arabian entertainment. BBQ dinner under the stars.

itinerary.title: Dubai Mall & Fountain Show
itinerary.description: Visit Dubai Mall for shopping. Watch the mesmerizing Dubai Fountain show. Optional: Visit Dubai Aquarium or ski at Ski Dubai.

itinerary.title: Abu Dhabi Day Trip
itinerary.description: Full day excursion to Abu Dhabi. Visit Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Emirates Palace, and Louvre Abu Dhabi. Return to Dubai in evening.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Breakfast at hotel. Check-out and transfer to airport for your return flight with unforgettable Dubai memories.

name: Kyoto, Japan
description: Immerse yourself in the cultural richness of Kyoto, Japan's ancient capital. Explore thousands of temples, traditional geisha districts, stunning gardens, and experience authentic Japanese culture and cuisine.
highlights: Visit the iconic Fushimi Inari Shrine with thousands of torii gates
Explore the golden Kinkaku-ji Temple
Walk through the enchanting Arashiyama Bamboo Grove
Experience traditional tea ceremony
Discover the historic Gion geisha district
included: 7 nights in traditional ryokan and modern hotels
Daily breakfast and 4 traditional Japanese dinners
All entry fees to temples and attractions

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kyoto
itinerary.description: Arrive at Kansai International Airport. Transfer to your hotel in Kyoto. Evening orientation walk around the hotel area.

itinerary.title: Northern Kyoto Temples
itinerary.description: Visit Kinkaku-ji (Golden Pavilion), Ryoan-ji rock garden, and Ninnaji Temple. Evening walk through Pontocho Alley.

itinerary.title: Fushimi Inari & Southern Kyoto
itinerary.description: Early morning visit to Fushimi Inari Shrine. Explore the thousands of vermillion torii gates. Visit Tofuku-ji Temple and traditional sake breweries.

itinerary.title: Arashiyama District
itinerary.description: Full day in Arashiyama. Walk through the famous Bamboo Grove, visit Tenryu-ji Temple, cross Togetsukyo Bridge, and ride the scenic railway.

itinerary.title: Cultural Experiences
itinerary.description: Participate in a traditional tea ceremony. Kimono wearing experience. Visit a geisha performance in Gion district. Explore Nishiki Market.

itinerary.title: Day Trip to Nara
itinerary.description: Excursion to nearby Nara. Visit Todai-ji Temple with the giant Buddha, Nara Park with friendly deer, and Kasuga Taisha Shrine.

itinerary.title: Eastern Kyoto
itinerary.description: Visit Kiyomizu-dera Temple, walk through Higashiyama district, explore Sanjusangendo Hall, and stroll along the Philosopher's Path.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Final breakfast at the hotel. Last-minute shopping for souvenirs. Transfer to airport for departure with cherished memories of Japan.

name: Santorini, Greece
description: Discover the stunning island of Santorini with its iconic white-washed buildings, blue-domed churches, and spectacular sunsets. Experience Greek hospitality, delicious cuisine, and the beauty of the Aegean Sea.
highlights: Watch the world-famous Oia sunset
Explore the ancient ruins of Akrotiri
Wine tasting at traditional wineries
Swim in the unique Red and Black beaches
Sail around the volcanic caldera
included: 5 nights in cave hotel with caldera view

itinerary.title: Arrival in Santorini
itinerary.description: Arrive at Santorini Airport. Transfer to your cave hotel in Oia or Fira. Settle in and enjoy the stunning caldera views. Evening at leisure.

itinerary.title: Island Tour
itinerary.description: Full day island tour visiting Pyrgos village, Megalochori, Prophet Elias Monastery, and the ancient ruins of Akrotiri. Sunset viewing at Oia.

itinerary.title: Beach Day
itinerary.description: Visit the famous Red Beach and Black Beach (Perissa). Enjoy swimming and sunbathing. Optional water sports activities. Beachside lunch at a traditional taverna.

itinerary.title: Wine & Culture
itinerary.description: Wine tasting tour visiting 3 traditional wineries. Learn about Santorini's unique viticulture. Visit Santo Winery with panoramic views. Evening free to explore Fira town.

itinerary.title: Catamaran Cruise
itinerary.description: Full day sunset catamaran cruise around the island. Sail through the caldera, swim in hot springs, visit the volcano, and enjoy BBQ on board. Watch the sunset from the sea.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Enjoy your final breakfast overlooking the caldera. Free time for last-minute shopping in Fira. Transfer to airport for your departure flight.

name: Leh-Ladakh
description: Embark on an unforgettable journey to the roof of the world. Experience the stark beauty of high-altitude deserts, pristine lakes, ancient monasteries, and the thrill of mountain passes in the majestic Himalayas.
highlights: Visit the stunning Pangong Lake
Explore ancient monasteries - Thiksey, Hemis, and Diskit
Drive through Khardung La, world's highest motorable road
Experience double-humped Bactrian camels at Nubra Valley
Marvel at the confluence of Indus and Zanskar rivers
included: All transfers and sightseeing in SUV vehicles
6 nights accommodation in hotels and camps
Inner line permits for restricted areas

itinerary.title: Arrival in Leh
itinerary.description: Arrive at Leh airport. Transfer to hotel. Complete rest for acclimatization to high altitude. Light walk in Leh market in evening. Overnight in Leh.

itinerary.title: Leh Local Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Visit Shanti Stupa, Leh Palace, and Hall of Fame museum. Explore local markets. Visit Sangam (confluence of Indus and Zanskar rivers). Overnight in Leh.

itinerary.title: Nubra Valley via Khardung La
itinerary.description: Drive to Nubra Valley via Khardung La Pass (18,380 ft). Visit Diskit Monastery and giant Buddha statue. Enjoy camel safari in Hunder sand dunes. Overnight in Nubra.

itinerary.title: Nubra to Pangong Lake
itinerary.description: Drive to Pangong Lake via Shyok route. Enjoy the changing colors of the lake. Photography at this stunning location. Overnight camping near Pangong Lake.

itinerary.title: Pangong to Leh
itinerary.description: Early morning at Pangong Lake. Drive back to Leh via Changla Pass. En-route visit Thiksey Monastery and Shey Palace. Evening free in Leh. Overnight in Leh.

itinerary.title: Monasteries Tour
itinerary.description: Full day excursion to Hemis Monastery, Stakna Monastery, and Magnetic Hill. Visit the colorful markets of Leh for souvenir shopping. Farewell dinner.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After breakfast, transfer to Leh airport for your onward journey with unforgettable memories of Ladakh.
